title: Tailoring alginate nanoparticles: influence of reverse micelle templates on structure, size, and encapsulation properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,7926-7937
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08616C, Paper

Fanny Melina Duque, R. Dario Falcone, N. Mariano Correa
Alginate nanoparticles (ALG-NPs) were synthesized in reverse micelles (RMs) as nanoreactors, exploring the role of interfacial charge on their structure, size, and encapsulation properties.
